transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you here today?

Yeah, thanks for seeing me. I guess what brings me in is... well, I'm having a lot of trouble at work lately. I'm a construction manager, and I just can't seem to stay focused on what's right in front of me. 

I'll start a safety briefing or sit down for a plan review, and I'll be trying really hard to pay attention. But within just a couple of minutes, my mind is already off thinking about three other job problems at the site. Because of that, I keep missing things—important details I know I should have caught. It's really starting to mess with my work, and I need to figure out what's going on.
Have you noticed yourself feeling unusually restless or fidgety, especially in situations where you’re supposed to stay still, like during meetings or when trying to focus on a task?

Yeah, definitely. Like, if we have a meeting where everybody else can just sit through the whole thing... I just can't do it. I'm always the guy standing up. 

I'll walk over to get another coffee, or I'll step outside to check on something, or I'll just make up some excuse to move around. I just have a really hard time staying in my seat.
Do you find yourself having similar problems with staying focused or feeling restless in other situations, like at home or when you're with friends or family?

Yeah, it's definitely not just at work. It's happening at home, too. 

At work, it's gotten pretty bad. Like I said, I'm missing things... I've dropped the ball on follow-ups and my site coordination has been so disorganized lately that my boss actually pulled me aside and gave me a formal warning about it. 

And at home... my wife is just exhausted. I tell her I'm going to handle something, like fixing something around the house or paying a bill, and I completely forget. She has to constantly remind me, over and over, and I know it's really wearing her down. So yeah, it's affecting pretty much everything right now.
Looking back, were you already having trouble focusing or feeling restless as a child, like before you were 12 years old?

Yeah, I was. Actually, back in elementary school, my teachers were already telling my parents about it. They said I couldn't stay in my seat, I was always talking out of turn, and I was constantly losing my homework. 

I also remember... I'd just rush through directions on assignments before I even really understood what I was supposed to be doing. So, yeah, it's been an issue since I was a kid.
